files.description: Single Patient EHI Export Data Overview and User Instructions. 4-page PDF describing the export process, directory structure, and data sources for single-patient exports. Explains SQL file organization (DDL schema, activity data, reference data) and multimedia/document imaging components.
Single Patient EHI Export Data Format Specifications ZIP. Contains: EHI MYSQL DATA MODEL 2025401.zip (1,456 HTML files documenting 6,604 tables) and Longitudinal Plan EHI Export - Single Patient.pdf.

Patient Population EHI Export Data Overview and User Instructions. 23-page PDF documenting the full population export including: core EHR data delivery (multi-tenant SQL vs single-tenant encrypted device), multimedia storage (DICOM and non-DICOM), document imaging, and longitudinal plan data. Includes appendices for DICOM structure, non-DICOM columns, and document imaging schema.

Patient Population EHI Export Data Format Specifications ZIP. Contains: EHI MYSQL DATA MODEL 2025401.zip, EHI ORACLE DATA MODEL 2025401.zip, Longitudinal Plan PDF, Document Imaging AxAnnotations.xsd, Document Imaging Content Management Database Schema.pdf, Multimedia Storage DICOM Data Structure.pdf, Multimedia Storage Non-DICOM Column Definitions.pdf.

Health Data Intelligence (HDI) EHI Export Data Overview and User Instructions. 3-page PDF documenting the HDI Longitudinal Record export via REST APIs (Longitudinal Record Bulk Extract API and Data Syndication API). Covers authentication, requesting exports, and downloading results.

Health Data Intelligence EHI Export Data Format Specifications. 8-page PDF (~20K lines) documenting the Avro-style entity model for the HDI Longitudinal Record export. Covers poprecord entities: actors, addresses, clinical events, codes, medications, observations, results, and many more.

Oracle Health Certified Health IT Transparency and Disclosure Information. 32-page PDF listing all certified modules, costs, and types of fees. Confirms EHI export capabilities exist for single patient and patient population exports.

files.description: Index page for the Millennium MySQL Data Model Reports (version 2025.4.01). Links to alphabetical table index and help page.
XML Schema Definition for document imaging annotations. Defines annotation types (rectangles, lines, text, highlights, redactions) used on scanned documents in Oracle Health Document Imaging.

files.description: DICOM data structure and definitions for Multimedia Storage exports. Includes sample XML for person/study data, hierarchical DICOM data organization, and entity definitions for patient identifiers, study instances, and series data.

files.description: Column definitions for non-DICOM multimedia storage CSV exports. Defines 8 columns: ObjectIdentifier, CompressionCode, GroupIdentifier, MimeTypeCode, OrigStoredTimeStamp, S3Path, SourceName, TransformationCode.
Bun TypeScript script that parses all 1,422 MySQL data model HTML pages and extracts structured JSON with table definitions, columns, types, and subject areas.

Structured JSON extraction of all 6,604 Millennium database tables with 129,148 columns. Each entry includes table name, description, definition, table type, subject area, source file, and full column detail (name, type, nullable, definition).
Extraction coverage report: 1,422 files parsed, 6,604 tables extracted, 129,148 columns, 242 subject areas, 0 parse failures. Includes per-subject-area table counts.
Enrichment README with run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
